armySpecialRules.name: ARROWS OF ASAPH
armySpecialRules.description: Units with the Arrows of Asaph special rule ignore all shooting modifiers that are not caused by magic items or spells.

armySpecialRules.name: CURSE OF THE NECROPOLIS
armySpecialRules.description:
If a model with this special rule is removed from play, then the enemy unit responsible – by inflicting the final wound, for example – will immediately suffer D6 Strength 5 hits (if the model was a Tomb King), D6 Strength 4 hits (if the model was a Tomb Prince) or D3 Strength 3 Hits (if the model was a Mummy). Any Wounds caused have the Ignores Armour Saves special rule.
If more than one unit is responsible for the destruction of the model with this special rule (it is destroyed by the combat result in a multiple combat due to its Unstable rule, for example), then all guilty units are affected. If the model is killed by a character, then only that model is cursed, and not the whole enemy unit.

armySpecialRules.name: ENTOMBED BENEATH THE SANDS
armySpecialRules.description:
A unit with this ability has the Ambushers special rule, with the following exceptions.
When these units enter the battle in the Remaining Moves sub-phase, they do not move onto the board as reinforcements in the normal way. Instead, when a unit that is Entombed Beneath the Sands enters the battle, place a small marker (max 1" diameter) anywhere on the battlefield, but not in impassable terrain or within 1" of a deployed unit.
Roll a scatter dice and an artillery dice. If you roll a Hit on the scatter dice, the marker stays in place. If you roll an arrow, move the marker the number, in inches, indicated by the artillery dice in the direction shown. If the marker is under a friendly unit, impassable terrain or a building, place it 1" away from the closest edge of the unit/terrain.
Once the final position of the marker is established, place the emerging unit in a legal formation such that it touches the marker, facing any direction. If the marker is under an enemy unit, you may place your unit into base contact with the enemy unit in their front arc; your unit will counts as charging this turn.
If you roll a misfire, or if for any reason some of the models in the unit cannot be placed, then the unit does not emerge. Instead, remove the marker and roll on the Mishap table. If a unit emerges successfully, it may act normally this turn.
If you have several units Entombed Beneath the Sands, then repeat this process, one unit at a time.

armySpecialRules.name: ENTOMBED BENEATH THE SANDS
armySpecialRules.description:
MISHAP TABLE
1-2 | Reclaimed by the Desert: The entire unit is destroyed and treated as casualties.
3-4 | Buried Too Deep: The unit is delayed and does not emerge – but you'll be able to try again next turn to see if it arrives, following the same process.
5-6 | Shifting Sands: The unit enters the battlefield from any point on a randomly determined board edge, moving on using the rules for reinforcements.

armySpecialRules.name: THE HIEROPHANT
armySpecialRules.description:
Your army must include at least one Wizard to be the army's Hierophant. If your army includes several Wizards, this will be the one with the highest Wizard Level. If two or more models have the highest Wizard Level, choose which of them will be the Hierophant. The Hierophant must use the Lore of Nehekhara.
The Hierophant, and all models in the same unit, have the Regeneration (6+) special rule.
At the end of the phase in which the Hierophant is removed as a casualty, and at the start of every friendly turn thereafter, all friendly Undead units (except characters) on the battlefield must take a Leadership test. If the test is failed, the unit immediately suffers a number of Wounds equal to the amount by which it failed the Leadership test, with no saves of any kind allowed. These Wounds are distributed as if from a shooting attack.
If, at the start of any of your turns following the death of the Hierophant, there is one or more friendly Wizard Characters on the table who know spells from the Lore of Nehekhara, then one of these models may be designated the new Hierophant by passing a Leadership test. If passed, they become the new Hierophant following all the normal rules, and no unit in the army needs to take the Leadership test to avoid losing Wounds while they remain alive.

armySpecialRules.name: INDOMITABLE
armySpecialRules.description: Models with this special rule suffer 1 Wound less than they normally would due to the Unstable special rule, or following the death of the army's Hierophant.

armySpecialRules.name: MY WILL BE DONE
armySpecialRules.description:
Any unit of Undead accompanied by a model with this rule uses the character's unmodified Weapon Skill in place of its own (use the highest Weapon Skill if the unit is joined by several characters with this rule).
If all characters with the My Will Be Done rule in the unit are killed, the unit immediately reverts to using its own Weapon Skill. This special rule has no effect on mounts or any other characters except Tomb Heralds – these always use their own Weapon Skill.

armySpecialRules.name: UNDEAD
armySpecialRules.description: All models with the Undead special rule have the Animated Construct, Fear, and Unstable special rules. In addition, they ignore the Independent special rule. However, they may make march moves if they are within 6" of the Hierophant or are joined by a character with the My Will Be Done special rule.

armySpecialRules.name: BANNER OF THE KING
armySpecialRules.description: In addition to the normal rules for the army battle standard, units of Undead within 12" of their battle standard suffer D3 Wounds less than they normally would due to the Unstable special rule, or following the death of the army's Hierophant.

magicItems.name: DESTROYER OF ETERNITIES
magicItems.description: Attacks made with the Destroyer of Eternities have the Heroic Killing Blow special rule. In addition, all enemy models in base contact with the wielder suffer a single automatic hit (with Heroic Killing Blow) after resolving the model's normal attacks. In a challenge, only the models engaged in the challenge count as being in base contact with the Tomb King.

magicItems.name: SPEAR OF ANTARHAK
magicItems.description: For every unsaved Wound inflicted by the Spear of Antarhak, the wielder immediately regains a single Wound lost earlier in the battle. If the bearer is already at their starting number of Wounds and inflicts another unsaved Wound with this weapon, they gain the Regeneration (4+) special rule until the end of the next player turn.

magicItems.name: CROOK AND FLAIL OF RADIANCE
magicItems.description: These weapons give the wielder the Always Strikes First special rule and a +1 Combat Resolution bonus.

magicItems.name: PHAKTH'S BLADES OF JUSTICE
magicItems.description: The wielder of these weapons gain +1 Attack for each complete rank any one enemy unit in base contact with them has.

magicItems.name: DAGGER OF BOUND SOULS
magicItems.description: No Magical Ward saves can be taken against Wounds caused by this item. In addition, any model that suffers an unsaved Wound from it must pass a Toughness test or suffer an additional Wound with no saves allowed. They must keep taking Toughness tests until they pass or are removed as a casualty.

magicItems.name: BLADE OF MOURNING
magicItems.description: If a unit suffers at least one unsaved Wound from the Blade of Mourning and loses the combat, any negative modifiers to the unit's Leadership for the subsequent Break test are doubled.

magicItems.name: BLADE OF SETEP
magicItems.description: The Blade of Setep gives the wielder the Ignores Armour Saves special rule. If the enemy model wears magical armour, the first Hit against this model is ignored, but the magical armour is destroyed for the remainder of the battle.

magicItems.name: BLADES OF HONOURABLE DEMISE
magicItems.description: The wielder of these weapons gain +1 To Hit in close combat.

magicItems.name: THE CONQUEROR'S BLADE
magicItems.description: The wielder of this weapon gains the Killing Blow special rule. When fighting in a challenge, they may re- roll failed To Wound rolls.

magicItems.name: STAFF OF AEONS
magicItems.description: If the wielder of this item successfully Hits an enemy unit in close combat, that unit suffers -1 to their armour saves for the duration of the game. This is not cumulative.

magicItems.name: SERPENT STAFF
magicItems.description: The Serpent Staff gives the wielder the Poisoned Attacks special rule. In addition, they may re- roll failed rolls To Wound.

magicItems.name: SCORPION ARMOUR
magicItems.description: The character can never suffer more than one wound due to combat resolution. If the wearer is with a unit, up to half the wounds suffered due to combat resolution can be allocated against the character, which are then ignored save for the first one.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF ETERNITY
magicItems.description: Enemy models must re-roll successful rolls To Wound against the wearer of this armour.

magicItems.name: VAMBRACES OF THE SUN
magicItems.description: This item gives the bearer a 6+ armour. In addition, all enemy models that attempt to strike the bearer in close combat suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: ARMOUR OF THE AGES
magicItems.description: When the wearer of this armour is reduced to their last Wound, they gain a Magical Ward (3+). This has no effect if they suffer their last Wound as a result of an attack that causes Multiple Wounds.

magicItems.name: GAUNTLET OF HRAKLONESH
magicItems.description: This item gives the bearer a 6+ armour save. In addition, they gain +1 Strength and Toughness. However, at the start of each of your turns, they must pass a Toughness test or suffer one Wound with no saves allowed.

magicItems.name: SHIELD OF PTRA
magicItems.description: The bearer of this shield gains the Parry (6+) special rule. If they make a successful Parry save, all models in base contact with them suffer -1 To Hit for the remainder of the turn, or the next turn if they have already attacked this turn.

magicItems.name: WARDING SPLINT
magicItems.description: This armour gives the wearer a Magical Ward (5+) in close combat.

magicItems.name: ROYAL MANTLE
magicItems.description: This item gives the bearer a 6+ armour save and the Inspiring Presence (6) special rule.

magicItems.name: GOLDEN ANKHRA
magicItems.description: The Ankhra gives the bearer a Magical Ward (4+). In addition, they may re-roll 1's when taking Magical Ward saves.

magicItems.name: AMULET OF PHA-STAH
magicItems.description: All enemy Talismans, Arcane Items and Enchanted Items have no effect while they remain in base contact with the wearer of the Amulet of Pha-Stah.

magicItems.name: GOLDEN EYE OF RAH-NUTT
magicItems.description: The Golden Eye gives the bearer a Magical Ward (3+) against missile attacks.

magicItems.name: COLLAR OF SHAPESH
magicItems.description: For each unsaved Wound the bearer suffers (before calculating any Multiple Wounds), roll a D6: on a 4+ the Wound is transferred to any friendly model in base contact of the bearers choosing, with no saves of any kind allowed. These Wounds still count towards combat resolution as normal. If there are no friendly models in base contact, then this rule has no effect.

magicItems.name: ORB OF PTRA
magicItems.description: All missile attacks targeting the bearer of this item or any unit they are with suffer -1 To Hit.

magicItems.name: BLUE KHEPRA
magicItems.description: The Blue Khepra makes the bearer (but not any unit they are with) immune to the effects of all enemy spells.

magicItems.name: BROOCH OF THE GREAT DESERT
magicItems.description: This item can be used against any enemy spell cast against the bearer or their unit, before attempting to dispel. When used, the bearer and any unit they are with gain the Magic Resistance (5) special rule for the remainder of the turn.

magicItems.name: RELIC OF THE DESERT SUN
magicItems.description: The bearer of the Relic of the Desert Sun gains a Magical Ward (6+) and Immunity (Flaming Attacks).

magicItems.name: ENKHIL'S KANOPI
magicItems.description: This is a special aura spell with a range of 24". Roll a D6 for every 'remains in play' and active spell that lasts more than one turn within range: on a 2+ that spell is automatically dispelled. For each spell that is ended in this way, add D3 power dice to your power pool.

magicItems.name: PHAZERAKT'S KANOPI
magicItems.description: This item contains an augment/summoning spell with a range of 12". You can choose to either summon 2D6+3 Skeleton Warriors to an existing unit or create a new unit. If creating a new unit, the models are only equipped with their default equipment.

magicItems.name: STAFF OF OSIRIS
magicItems.description: This item contains a magic missile with a range of 24". It inflicts a single Strength 6 hit with the Armour Piercing (1) and Multiple Wounds (D3) special rules that penetrates ranks in the same manner as a shot from a Bolt Thrower.

magicItems.name: STAFF OF RAVENING
magicItems.description: The Staff of Ravening contains a magic missile spell with a range of 18" that causes 3D6 Strength 2 hits.

magicItems.name: NEFERRA'S SCROLLS OF MIGHTY INCANTATIONS
magicItems.description: A Wizard can declare that he is using Neferra's Scrolls of Mighty Incantations immediately before casting a spell. If he does so, the Wizard must add a number of extra bonus dice, equal to his Wizard level, to the power dice he is going to roll (you still need to roll at least one dice from the power pool). The bonus dice do not count as power dice. However, a roll of any double (except 1's) when initially casting a spell using them will counts as rolling a 6 for the purpose of Ultimate Power.

magicItems.name: STAFF OF AWAKENING
magicItems.description: The wielder of the Staff of Awakening may re- roll the amount of Wounds recovered from The Restless Dead when casting spells.

magicItems.name: CURSE-WEAVER WAND
magicItems.description: The Curse-weaver Wand gives the bearer a +2 casting bonus when casting hex spells.

magicItems.name: STAFF OF MASTERY
magicItems.description: The Staff of Mastery gives the bearer a +1 casting bonus when using the Lore of Light.

magicItems.name: HIERATIC JAR
magicItems.description: The Hieratic Jar may be used at the start of any of your Magic phases. The bearer immediately gains +D3 Power dice. Only they may use these extra Power dice.

magicItems.name: TABLET OF TAHOTH
magicItems.description: This item may be used after rolling the Power dice to cast a spell. When used, add a +D3 casting bonus to the roll.

magicItems.name: GOLDEN DEATH MASK OF KHARNUTT
magicItems.description: The model wearing this mask causes Terror. In addition, enemy units within 6" of the wearer cannot benefit from the Inspiring Presence or Hold Your Ground special rules.

magicItems.name: CLOAK OF THE DUNES
magicItems.description: The wearer of the Cloak of Dunes has the Fly (10) special rule. In addition, if the bearer moves over an unengaged enemy unit in the Remaining Moves sub-phase, that enemy unit immediately suffers 2D6 Strength 2 hits, resolved as missile attacks against the rear. The bearer can move over several enemy units in the same turn if you wish, causing damage to every unit. The same target unit cannot be affected more than once in the same turn.

magicItems.name: AMULET OF THE SERPENT
magicItems.description: The bearer of the Amulet of the Serpent and any unit they join gain the Poisoned Attacks special rule in close combat.

magicItems.name: SCARAB BROOCH
magicItems.description: All models using the Entombed Beneath the Sands special rule may re-roll failed rolls to enter the battlefield and can re-roll the scatter and/or artillery dice when emerging if their marker is within 12" of the bearer of this item.

magicItems.name: CROWN OF KINGS
magicItems.description: All friendly units within 6" may make March moves despite being Undead.

magicItems.name: CHARIOT OF FIRE
magicItems.description: The model's Chariot causes 2D6 Impacts Hits with the Flaming Attacks and Magical Attacks special rules.

magicItems.name: ICON OF RULERSHIP
magicItems.description: The Icon of Rulership gives the bearer a +1 Combat Resolution bonus.

magicItems.name: KARITAMEN'S DEATH MASK
magicItems.description: The bearer of this item gains +1 Leadership and the Disciplined special rule.

magicItems.name: ICON OF THE SACRED EYE
magicItems.description: The unit carrying the Icon of the Sacred Eye (including any mounts) may re-roll failed rolls To Hit in the first round of close combat.

magicItems.name: ROYAL STANDARD OF SETTRA
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Hatred (Characters) and Fear special rules.

magicItems.name: TAPESTRY OF CONQUERED LANDS
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains a +D3 Combat Resolution bonus (roll each time it is used).

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE HIDDEN DEAD
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Entombed Beneath the Sands special rule.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF THE CURSING WORD
magicItems.description: All enemy units in base contact with the unit carrying the Standard of the Cursing Word must pass a Leadership test or suffer D6 Wounds which Ignores Armour Saves at the start of each round of close combat.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF THE UNDYING LEGION
magicItems.description: This banner contains an augment spell that targets the bearer's unit. If successfully cast, the bearer's unit immediately recovers a number of Wounds' worth of models, as described in the Restless Dead.

magicItems.name: ICON OF RAKAPH
magicItems.description: The unit carrying the Icon of Rakaph may make a Turn at the start of their Movement phase instead of the Remaining Moves sub-phase. The unit may then move as normal (including declaring charges).
magicItems.restriction: Tomb Guard or Tomb Herald on foot

magicItems.name: SIGIL OF CENTURIES
magicItems.description: All enemy units within 6" of this standard are subject to the Always Strikes Last special rule.

magicItems.name: STANDARD OF THE SANDS
magicItems.description: The Standard of the Sands may be activated at the beginning of any enemy Movement phase. For the remainder of the turn, no models within 24" of the banner may March, and all units attempting to rally suffer -1 to their Leadership.

magicItems.name: BANNER OF THE DESERT WINDS
magicItems.description: The unit carrying this standard gains the Swiftstride and Vanguard special rules.

magicItems.name: MIRAGE STANDARD
magicItems.description: The Mirage Standard forces all Hits from missile attacks targeting the unit carrying it to be re-rolled.

loresOfMagic.name: THE LORE OF NEHEKHARA
loresOfMagic.attribute: Each time a Wizard successfully casts an augment or conveyance spell from the Lore of Nehekhara, the target of the spell immediately recovers a number of Wounds' worth of models, just like a summoning spell. Core Units (except Chariots) recover D6+1 Wounds. Special Units, Chariots and Monstrous Cavalry recover D3 Wounds. All other units recover 1 Wound.

spells.name: KHSAR'S INCANTATION OF THE DESERT WIND
spells.description: Khsar's Incantation of the Desert Wind is a conveyance spell with a range of 24". The target can immediately make a normal move as if it were the Remaining Moves sub-phase.

spells.name: DJEDRA'S INCANTATION OF THE ETERNAL DEAD
spells.description: Remains in play. Djedra's Incantation of the Eternal Dead is an augment spell that is cast on the Wizard itself (this can trigger The Restless Dead for any unit they are with). While this spell is in effect, add +1 to the result of all Wounds recovered from the The Restless Dead due to spells being cast by this Wizard.

spells.name: SEKHUBI'S INCANTATION OF RETRIBUTION
spells.description: Sekhubi's Incantation of Retribution is a magic missile with a range of 30" that causes D6 Strength 4 hits.

spells.name: DJAF'S INCANTATION OF CURSED BLADES
spells.description: Djaf's Incantation of Cursed Blades is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target unit's close combat Attacks gain the Killing Blow special rule until the start of your next Magic phase.

spells.name: MERNEPTAH'S INCANTATION OF THE SCARAB SONG
spells.description: Merneptah's Scroll of the Scarab Song is a direct damage area spell with a range of 24" that uses the large round template. All models under the template suffer a Strength 1 hit with the Poisoned Attacks special rule.

spells.name: PTRA'S INCANTATION OF RIGHTEOUS SMITING
spells.description: Ptra's Incantation of Righteous Smiting is an augment spell with a range of 18". All models in the target unit gain +1 Attack and may fire an additional shot with missile weapons (excluding artillery) until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: NERU'S INCANTATION OF PROTECTION
spells.description: Neru's Incantation of Protection is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target unit gains a Magical Ward (5+) until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: RETURN OF THE GOLDEN AGE
spells.description: Return of the Golden Age is an augment spell with a range of 18". The target unit gains +1 Weapon Skill, Strength and Initiative until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: USIRIAN'S INCANTATION OF VENGEANCE
spells.description: Usirian's Incantation of Vengeance is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target unit suffers -D3 to its Movement characteristic (to a minimum of 1) and treats all terrain (even open ground) as Dangerous Terrain, testing every time it moves (including when charging, fleeing, pursuing, moving compulsorily, etc.) until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: NEFERRE'S INCANTATION OF QUAKING HORROR
spells.description: Neferre's Incantation of Quaking Horror is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target halves their Leadership (after modifiers, rounding up) until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: USEKHP'S INCANTATION OF DESICCATION
spells.description: Usekhp's Incantation of Desiccation is a hex spell with a range of 24". The target unit has -1 Strength and -1 Toughness (to a minimum of 1) until the start of the caster's next Magic phase.

spells.name: MANKARA'S INCANTATION OF URGENCY
spells.description: Mankara's Incantation of Urgency is a conveyance spell with a range of 12". The target can immediately move using the Random Movement (3D6) special rule.

spells.name: SAKHMET'S INCANTATION OF THE SKULLSTORM
spells.description: Remains in play. Sakhmet's Incantation of the Skullstorm is a magical vortex that uses the small round template. Any model touched by the template at any point during its move suffers a Strength 5 hit. Any unit that suffers one or more casualties must take an immediate Panic test.
